# IV Infotech

> IV Infotech is an IT services company based in Mehsana, Gujarat, India, offering web development, mobile app development, CRM/ERP solutions, e-commerce development, digital marketing, UI/UX design, web hosting, and AI automation services for startups, SMEs, and enterprises across India.

## Services

- [Custom Mobile Application Development](https://www.ivinfotech.com/custom-mobile-application-development): Custom Android, iOS, Flutter & React Native mobile app development company and services in India, with real client case studies
- [Custom Website & Software Development](https://www.ivinfotech.com/custom-website-software-development): Custom website and software development solutions
- [CRM & ERP Custom Software Development](https://www.ivinfotech.com/crm-erp-custom-software-development): Custom CRM and ERP software development
- [E-Commerce Solution](https://www.ivinfotech.com/ecommerce-website-app-development-india): E-commerce website and app development in India
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.ivinfotech.com/digital-marketing): SEO, PPC, and digital marketing services
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.ivinfotech.com/ui-ux-design-agency-india): UI/UX design agency services in India
- [Web Hosting Services](https://www.ivinfotech.com/best-web-hosting-services): Web hosting services
- [AI & Automation](https://www.ivinfotech.com/ai-automation): AI and automation solutions for businesses

## Case Studies

- [Salon Appointment Booking Website — Rosenthal Barbershop](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/salon-appointment-booking-website-development): Custom salon booking system with multi-barber scheduling, real-time slots, and full admin dashboard
- [Institute Management Software Development](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/custom-institute-management-software-case-study): Education ERP automating student management, fee collection, attendance, and inquiries
- [PawCount – Animal Welfare & Dog Tracking Software](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/animal-welfare-dog-tracking-software): GIS-powered platform for stray dog surveys, ABC programs, and shelter management
- [AI-Ready Travel Portal — SafarVibes](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/ai-ready-travel-portal-safarvibes-success-story): Mobile-first, AEO-ready travel booking platform
- [Smart Mandi — Agriculture ERP & E-commerce Solution](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/agri-tech-erp-mandi-workflow-automation): APMC digital transformation with 45% higher operational efficiency and 60% faster payment settlement
- [Scalable Job Portal & SaaS Recruitment Software](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/custom-job-portal-saas-recruitment-software): Laravel and Flutter-based multi-tenant recruitment platform
- [Healthcare SaaS Ecosystem — Eye Care Hospital](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/eye-care-hospital-software-india): Web & mobile app architecture for hospital digital transformation
- [Ecommerce Website Development — Belzzo](https://ivinfotech.com/portfolio/ecommerce-website-for-footwear-brand): High-converting ecommerce store for a footwear brand
